guideMeta.title: Application Guide
guideMeta.description: A step-by-step guide to applying a tooth gem at home in 10 minutes — from prep and Etch gel to UV curing.
guideMeta.ogDescription: Salon results at home in 10 minutes — a step-by-step application guide.

guidePage.introSub: Salon results at home in 10 minutes.
guidePage.step1Tip: The tooth needs to be completely dry for the next step.
guidePage.step2Action1: Apply a small amount of Etch gel to the tooth (blue bottle)
guidePage.step3Title: Remove the Etch gel and dry
guidePage.step3Action1: Remove the Etch gel from the tooth with a cotton roll
guidePage.step4Action1: Apply a small amount of adhesive to the tooth (white bottle)
guidePage.step4Action2: Use the micro brush for this
guidePage.step5Action1: Place the crystal onto the adhesive
guidePage.step5Tip: Don't move the crystal once it's placed.
guidePage.step6Action1: Cure for 3 × 45 seconds with the UV lamp
guidePage.aftercareAction1: Don't eat or drink for 1 hour
guidePage.aftercareAction2: Avoid hard and sticky foods for 24 hours
